**“Best” – what does it mean?** In film circles “best” can refer to different things: | Category | Winner / Top‑rated films (2020) | |----------|--------------------------------| | **Academy Award – Best Picture** | *The Trial of the Chicago Seven* (directed by Aaron Sorkin) | | **Golden Globe – Best Motion Picture – Drama** | *Parasite* (dir. Bong Joon‑ho) | | **BAFTA Film Awards – Outstanding British Contribution to Cinema** | *Tenet* (though not a BAFTA award itself, it topped many UK year‑end lists) | | **Critics’ Choice Movie Awards – Favorite Action/Adventure & Thriller** | *Tenet*, *Mulan* | | **Rotten Tomatoes “Top Rated Movies of 2020”** | • *Parasite*
• *1917*
• *Jojo Rabbit*
• *Soul*
• *The Invisible Man* | ### Why those stand out 1. **The Trial of the Chicago Seven** - A courtroom drama tackling civil unrest and political dissent during the Vietnam War era. - Strong ensemble cast (Ethan Hawke, Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Mark Rylance). - Won the Academy’s Best Picture; praised for its sharp dialogue and timely themes. 2. **Parasite** - South Korean dark comedy thriller that won both Best International Feature Film and Best Original Screenplay at the Oscars. - Critically acclaimed worldwide for its genre‑blending narrative and social critique. 3. **Tenet** - Christopher Nolan’s high‑concept action sci‑fi featuring time inversion mechanics. - Though polarizing among audiences, it dominated technical categories (visual effects, sound design) and received strong reviews from many mainstream outlets. 4. **Other notable mentions** - *1917*: Ridley Scott’s war epic known for its continuous‑shot illusion. - *Jojo Rabbit*: Taika Waititi’s satirical take on WWII. - *Soul*: Pixar’s introspective animated feature exploring life after death. - *The Invisible Man*: Modern horror reimagining of H.G. Wells’ classic. --- #### Bottom line If you’re looking for what most major institutions crowned as “the best,” **_The Trial of the Chicago Seven_** holds that title via the Oscars. However, if your definition leans toward critical consensus or cultural impact, **_Parasite_**, **_Tenet_**, and several others could equally claim the spot depending on which metric matters most to you.
